title: Beautiful fountains rows
statementMd:
Butler Ostin wants to show Arkady that rows of odd number of fountains are beautiful, while rows of even number of fountains are not.

The butler wants to show Arkady $*n*$ gardens. Each garden is a row of $*m*$ cells, the $*i*$-th garden has one fountain in each of the cells between $*l*_{*i*}$ and $*r*_{*i*}$ inclusive, and there are no more fountains in that garden. The issue is that some of the gardens contain even number of fountains, it is wrong to show them to Arkady.

Ostin wants to choose two integers $*a* ≤ *b*$ and show only part of each of the gardens that starts at cell $*a*$ and ends at cell $*b*$. Of course, only such segments suit Ostin that each garden has either zero or odd number of fountains on this segment. Also, it is necessary that at least one garden has at least one fountain on the segment from $*a*$ to $*b*$.

Help Ostin to find the total length of all such segments, i.e. sum up the value $(*b* - *a* + 1)$ for each suitable pair $(*a*, *b*)$.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 2·10^{5}$) — the number of gardens and the length of each garden.

$*n*$ lines follow. The $*i*$-th of these lines contains two integers $*l*_{*i*}$ and $*r*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *l*_{*i*} ≤ *r*_{*i*} ≤ *m*$) — the bounds of the segment that contains fountains in the $*i*$-th garden.

## Output

Print one integer: the total length of all suitable segments.

## Note

In the first example the following pairs suit Ostin: $(*a*, *b*)$: $(1, 2)$, $(1, 4)$, $(1, 5)$, $(2, 2)$, $(2, 4)$, $(2, 5)$, $(3, 3)$, $(4, 4)$, $(4, 5)$.

In the second example the following pairs suit Ostin: $(*a*, *b*)$: $(1, 2)$, $(1, 5)$, $(2, 2)$, $(2, 5)$, $(3, 3)$, $(4, 4)$, $(4, 6)$, $(5, 5)$, $(6, 6)$.
statementZhMd:
管家 Ostin 想向 Arkady 证明，拥有奇数个喷泉的行是美丽的，而拥有偶数个喷泉的行并不美丽。

管家想向 Arkady 展示 $*n*$ 个花园。每个花园都是一行包含 $*m*$ 个单元格的网格，第 $*i*$ 个花园中，编号在 $*l*_{*i*}$ 到 $*r*_{*i*}$（含）之间的每个单元格各有一个喷泉，除此之外该花园中没有其他喷泉。问题在于，有些花园包含偶数个喷泉，不能将它们展示给 Arkady。

Ostin 想选择两个整数 $*a* ≤ *b*$，并且只展示每个花园中从单元格 $*a*$ 开始到单元格 $*b*$ 结束的部分。当然，只有满足每个花园在该区间内的喷泉数量均为零或奇数的线段才适合 Ostin。此外，还必须至少有一个花园在从 $*a*$ 到 $*b*$ 的线段上包含至少一个喷泉。

请帮助 Ostin 求出所有满足条件的线段的总长度，即对每个合适的数对 $(*a*, *b*)$ 求和 $(*b* - *a* + 1)$。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 2·10^{5}$）——花园的数量以及每个花园的长度。

接下来有 $*n*$ 行。第 $*i*$ 行包含两个整数 $*l*_{*i*}$ 和 $*r*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *l*_{*i*} ≤ *r*_{*i*} ≤ *m*$）——第 $*i*$ 个花园中包含喷泉的线段的边界。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数：所有满足条件的线段的总长度。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，以下数对适合 Ostin：$(*a*, *b*)$：$(1, 2)$、$(1, 4)$、$(1, 5)$、$(2, 2)$、$(2, 4)$、$(2, 5)$、$(3, 3)$、$(4, 4)$、$(4, 5)$。

在第二个样例中，以下数对适合 Ostin：$(*a*, *b*)$：$(1, 2)$、$(1, 5)$、$(2, 2)$、$(2, 5)$、$(3, 3)$、$(4, 4)$、$(4, 6)$、$(5, 5)$、$(6, 6)$。
